notes: Entity disambiguation: 'Autorijschool Zainab' is a sole proprietorship (eenmanszaak, KvK 96318481, vestiging 000061652687), CBR rijschoolnummer 1417X7, registered/active since 2025 (CBR Open Data via rijloket.nl: 'Actief sinds 2025'); very small volume (CBR: 5 first exams total, 2 in 2025 dataset, ~40% pass rate).
